svg.aria-label: The pipeline of one roadmap entry as boxes in order: /repo-setup for a new repository or /ordo-init for an existing one, /roadmap add, the optional /grill, /plan, every step, and the closing, with the optional /plan-retro, /session-retro, /diagnose and /ordo-help beside them. Each box lists the stops where you are asked, marked every run, only when or optional.
